『なんで、お前達がここにいるの』――ミリアムからこぼれた言葉は、\n敵意のトゲに: "Why are you guys here?"――The words that slipped from Miriam's mouth were filled with thorns of hostility.

（『嫌がらせ』……か。\nもしかして、あの子達は以前言っていた――）: ("Harassment"... huh. Could those girls be the ones they were talking about before――)
……私達は貴族といってもそういいところの出じゃありません。\nそれこそカークラン: ...Even though we're nobles, we don't come from such a grand background. It's a night-and-day difference compared to the Ducal House of Kirkland.
だから、生活なんて平民と大して変わんないし、\n貴族としての自覚？ なんてものも: So our lifestyle isn't all that different from commoners, and awareness as nobles? We didn't have anything like that at all～!
だ、だからか……入学してから、ちょっとトラブルがあって……\n攻撃的な人達に、標: M-Maybe that's why... after entering the academy, we had a bit of trouble... We were targeted by aggressive people... and had bad things said about us...
（まさかこんなところで遭遇するとはな……\nクラウディアやドロテア、リュシー達は: (To think we'd run into them in a place like this... It seems Claudia, Dorothea, and Lucy decided to watch over things for now.)

ええ。なんとか爵位を手放すまではいかなかったけど、もう前みたいな\n影響力なんて: Yes. We somehow managed to avoid giving up our title, but we no longer have the influence we used to... With the harmony policies as well, we're nobles in name only now.
落ちぶれた途端、今までうちを頼ってた周囲の人達は離れていって……\n同時にバカに: The moment we fell from grace, the people around us who used to rely on us left... and at the same time, the number of people making fun of us grew...
自分がいかに家名を笠に着てたかを知ったわ。\nすごいのは先祖の作り上げたブランド: I realized how much I was hiding behind my family name. The impressive thing was the brand built by my ancestors, not myself.
そういえば……\n取り巻きのひと、ひとり減ってますね。: Come to think of it... you're missing one of your followers.
……最近は連絡も来なくなってしまったわね。でも仕方ないわ。\nあの子は私じゃなく: ...She stopped contacting me recently. But it can't be helped. She was a friend of the "Count's daughter," not a friend of mine.
私に誰かを否定したり、見下したり、\n怒ったりする資格なんてなかった。: I never had the right to deny anyone, look down on anyone, or get angry at anyone.

可能なら……あのときのことを謝って、精算したいの。\n本当に、申し訳ありませんで: If possible... I want to apologize for back then and clear the air. I am truly, deeply sorry.

そのせいか、リアクションに戸惑って言葉を返せないでいた。: Perhaps because of that, they were bewildered on how to react and couldn't find the words to respond.

ただどっちも黙り込んでしまって、会話に進展がない。\n取り巻きもリーダーを立てる: However, both sides fell silent, and there was no progress in the conversation. The followers didn't intervene either, perhaps intending to let their leader handle it.
……コホン。お前らもこのフェスに参加しにきたのか？: ...Ahem. Did you guys come to participate in this festival too?

その御恩返しもあって、家をあげてこのフェスへ協力させて\nいただいてるんです。よ: Partly to repay that favor, our whole family is assisting with this festival. We heard they wanted as many nobles to participate as possible.

一応明日のコンテストにも参加するつもりよ。: We plan on participating in tomorrow's contest as well.
じゃあ……コンテストは正々堂々ってことでいいんだよな？: Then... we can count on a fair and square contest, right?
え、ええ！ もちろんです。勝負しようって感じではありませんが、\nお互いいいパフ: Y-Yes! Of course. It's not like we're looking to compete fiercely, but I hope both sides can put on a good performance.
……じゃあ、私達そろそろ行ってもいいかしら。: ...Well then, may we be on our way soon?

……それが、本音なんだ。\n形だけの謝罪でどうにかしようって……そういうことなん: ...So that's how you really feel. You just tried to manage things with a superficial apology... Is that how it is?
